question: What is the square of 71?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Square of 71 using (a+b)² logic:

71² = (70 + 1)²

→ 70² + (2 × 70 × 1) + 1²

→ 4900 + 140 + 1 = 5041

**∴ The correct option is (4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Number = 71

Formula Used: Square of a number n = n × n

⇒ Square of 71 = 71 × 71

⇒ Square of 71 = 71 × (70 + 1)

⇒ Square of 71 = (71 × 70) + (71 × 1)

⇒ Square of 71 = 4970 + 71

⇒ Square of 71 = 5041

**∴ The correct option is (4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity for Squaring

The identity (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² helps in breaking down numbers into easier components for mental calculation.

Units Digit Property

Any number ending in 1 will always have a square that also ends in 1, as 1 × 1 = 1.

Base Method (Near 50)

For numbers near 50: (50 + x)² = (25 + x) along with x². For 71, x = 21: (25 + 21) | 21² = 46 | 441 = 5041.
